name: ContextEcho
description: ContextEcho v2.0 is a consented, redacted corpus of real long agentic-coding sessions plus a persona-drift benchmark built on top of it. The analysis corpus contains 57 sessions: 54 accepted community donations (29 Claude Code + 25 Codex CLI) plus the 3 founding sessions from the v1 release (Claude Code; 445-1,242 user turns each), i.e. 32 Claude Code + 25 Codex CLI; 28-2,484 user turns per session (one user + assistant round per turn), 12,210 user turns in total; 42 of 57 sessions contain at least one in-session context compaction (169 compaction events). The ledger and session directory additionally carry one SUPERSEDED duplicate submission (submission-607d8b75), retained for provenance and excluded from all analyses; intake-level counts over all 55 community files are 225,570 JSONL records, 40,787 tool-call records, a ledger turns field summing to 12,337 (a broader intake definition than the paper's user turn), and 157 compaction markers (155 over the 54 accepted). Every community session was donated through a local-first redaction wizard, reviewed by maintainers, and promoted with an explicit per-donation CONSENT.md, manifest.json, and review_report.json; provenance is tracked in an append-only donations ledger (ledger.jsonl). The release also ships derived per-session results tables (summary_v2.0.csv drift-gap summaries, figure_inputs_v2.0.csv lexical proxies, compactions_rederived.csv compaction-count cross-validation). The corpus is extensible by design: new donations are promoted through the same pipeline and appended to the ledger, so the benchmark grows as a living, versioned dataset.
citeAs: @article{ding2026contextecho, title={ContextEcho: A Benchmark for Persona Drift in Long Agentic-Coding Sessions}, author={Ding, Xianzhong and Yu, Yangyang and Liu, Changwei and Zhao, Bill}, journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2605.24279}, year={2026}}

creator.name: ContextEcho contributors (pseudonymous contributor community)
creator.description: The corpus is built from community donations. Donors are credited pseudonymously ('Anonymous donor <id>') on the public contributor leaderboard in CONTRIBUTORS.md; donor identity fields are maintainer-visible only, per DONOR_PRIVACY.md.

usageInfo: Allowed uses (DATA_USE_POLICY.md; mirrored in each donation manifest as allowed_uses=['persona_drift_benchmarking']): persona drift benchmarking; model behavior analysis in long agentic-coding sessions; redaction, validation, and aggregate dataset quality checks; reproduction of ContextEcho figures and claims. Disallowed uses: donor profiling; psychological or sentiment analysis of donors; employment, productivity, or performance evaluation of donors; attempts to deanonymize donors, organizations, repositories, or private paths.
rai:dataUseCases: Persona-drift benchmarking on real long agentic-coding sessions: snapshot a real session prefix, fork the conversation state, probe any chat-completions target with the 25-probe identity suite, and score with an LLM-judge rubric plus judge-free metrics. The corpus supports compaction-aligned checkpoints (169 compaction events across 42 of the 57 analysis sessions), cross-harness comparison (Claude Code vs Codex CLI), and mitigation studies (anchor dosing). Out of scope per DATA_USE_POLICY.md: any analysis of the donors themselves.
rai:dataLimitations: Sessions are a convenience sample of self-selected donors (24 institutions, 2 harnesses, mostly agentic-coding and web-frontend work, predominantly English). Metadata fields carry per-field confidence levels in each manifest (metadata_confidence); model and compaction counts are 'medium' confidence for some donations and are cross-validated in compactions_rederived.csv. Transcripts are redacted, not raw: PII, secrets, paths, URLs, and usernames are replaced with placeholders, and 3 sessions use the stricter user_minimized tier that additionally masks sensitive donor-authored spans.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: All sessions pass a local-first redaction pipeline on the donor machine (Presidio-based PERSON/EMAIL/IP/PHONE/CREDIT_CARD/URL/CRYPTO detection, home-path and username pseudonymization, API-key/secret pattern removal, detect-secrets entropy scan, donor-chosen scrub terms) followed by a fail-closed local verification step and an independent maintainer PII review before promotion. Privacy tiers: full_redacted (default; 52 of 55 community sessions) and user_minimized (3 of 55; additionally masks sensitive donor-authored spans). Each donor attests in CONSENT.md that the session contains no client-confidential material and no other person's personal data.

distribution.name: github-repository
distribution.description: ContextEcho release repository containing the v2 data archive (data_archive_release_v2/), the v1 founding-session archive (data_archive_release/), the benchmark harness, and governance documents (DATASET_CARD.md, DATA_USE_POLICY.md, DONOR_PRIVACY.md, DATASHEET.md).

distribution.name: community-sessions
distribution.description: 55 community-donated redacted session transcripts (30 Claude Code + 25 Codex CLI; 54 ACCEPTABLE + 1 SUPERSEDED duplicate, submission-607d8b75, excluded from analyses), one JSONL file per session, named session_<donation-label>.jsonl. Intake totals over the 55 files: 225,570 records (40,787 tool-call records; ledger turns field summing to 12,337 under an intake turn definition broader than the paper's user turn). Each file's harness/schema is given by the source_format field of its ledger row ('claude-code-jsonl' or 'codex-cli-jsonl'); its provenance, consent, and review artifacts live in data_archive_release_v2/data/donations/<label>/.

distribution.name: session_raw_transcript.jsonl
distribution.description: Founding session S1 (v1 release): donated Claude Code session, 1,242 user turns, 6 compactions. Claude Code JSONL schema.

distribution.name: session_proeng.jsonl
distribution.description: Founding session S2 (v1 release): donated Claude Code session, 445 user turns, 3 compactions. Claude Code JSONL schema.

distribution.name: session_chainassemble.jsonl
distribution.description: Founding session S3 (v1 release): donated Claude Code session, 458 user turns, 5 compactions. Claude Code JSONL schema.

distribution.name: ledger.jsonl
distribution.description: Append-only public donation ledger: one JSON row per promoted community donation (55 rows: 54 ACCEPTABLE + 1 SUPERSEDED). Source of truth for session provenance, harness/model/domain composition, per-field metadata confidence, contributor credit, and the contributor leaderboard.

distribution.name: summary_v2.0.csv
distribution.description: Baseline benchmark results: per-session mean drift gap for the 57-session accepted population (54 community + 3 founding), from the compact_validation_v1 run (57 sessions x 3 checkpoints x 5 coding probes x {real, filler} arms; target claude-sonnet-5, judge claude-sonnet-4-6).

distribution.name: figure_inputs_v2.0.csv
distribution.description: Per-session lexical drift proxies and session-shape covariates (turns, compactions, assistant message counts, response-length and register-marker rates) used as figure inputs and predictor features.

distribution.name: compactions_rederived.csv
distribution.description: Compaction-count cross-validation: per-session compaction counts re-derived from JSONL top-level markers (Claude Code: type=system, subtype=compact_boundary; Codex CLI: type=compacted) reconciled against donor manifests and figure inputs. All sources agree (0 disagreements). Paper numbers (57 analysis sessions = 54 accepted community + 3 founding): 42/57 sessions with >=1 compaction, 169 events. Over all 58 session files including the superseded duplicate: 43/58 and 171 events (40/55 and 157 for the 55 community files; 39/54 and 155 for the accepted community files).

recordSet.name: claude-code-records
recordSet.description: One record per JSONL line in a Claude Code session (community sessions with ledger source_format='claude-code-jsonl', plus the 3 founding sessions). Top-level record types include: 'user' (user turn), 'assistant' (assistant turn, including tool_use blocks inside message.content), 'system' (harness events; subtype='compact_boundary' marks an in-session context compaction), 'attachment', 'file-history-snapshot', 'mode', 'permission-mode', 'ai-title', 'last-prompt', and 'queue-operation'. Not every field is present on every record type.

field.name: type
field.description: Top-level record type: user | assistant | system | attachment | file-history-snapshot | mode | permission-mode | ai-title | last-prompt | queue-operation.

field.name: sessionId
field.description: Session identifier (redacted/pseudonymized in the release).

field.name: uuid
field.description: Unique record id; parentUuid links a record to its parent, giving the conversation DAG.

field.name: parentUuid
field.description: uuid of the parent record (null for roots).

field.name: timestamp
field.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock timestamp of the record (present on user/assistant/system/attachment records).

field.name: isSidechain
field.description: True when the record belongs to a subagent sidechain rather than the main conversation thread.

field.name: message
field.description: Message payload for user/assistant records: role plus content blocks (text, tool_use, tool_result). Assistant tool_use blocks are the corpus's tool-call events (40,787 across the 55 community sessions). All content is post-redaction.

field.name: subtype
field.description: Subtype of 'system' records. subtype='compact_boundary' is the compaction marker used to derive the 157 (155 over the 54 accepted files) community-session compaction events.

field.name: cwd
field.description: Working directory at record time (paths redacted to placeholders).

field.name: gitBranch
field.description: Git branch active at record time, when available.

recordSet.name: codex-cli-records
recordSet.description: One record per JSONL line in a Codex CLI session (community sessions with ledger source_format='codex-cli-jsonl'). Every record is {type, timestamp, payload}. Top-level types: 'session_meta' (one per file: cli_version, cwd, model_provider, originator), 'turn_context' (per-turn model/approval/sandbox configuration), 'event_msg' (harness events; payload.type includes user_message, agent_message, task_started, task_complete, token_count, context_compacted, patch_apply_end, web_search_end), 'response_item' (model-stream items; payload.type includes message, reasoning, function_call, function_call_output, custom_tool_call, custom_tool_call_output, web_search_call), and 'compacted' (context-compaction marker with replacement_history).

field.name: type
field.description: Top-level record type: session_meta | turn_context | event_msg | response_item | compacted. type='compacted' is the compaction marker used in the compaction counts.

field.name: timestamp
field.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock timestamp of the record.

field.name: payload
field.description: Type-specific payload object (post-redaction). For event_msg/response_item records, payload.type discriminates the event; message content lives in payload.message / payload.content; tool calls are response_item records with payload.type in {function_call, custom_tool_call} and their *_output counterparts.

field.name: payload_type
field.description: payload.type discriminator for event_msg and response_item records (e.g. user_message, agent_message, function_call, function_call_output, reasoning, context_compacted).

recordSet.name: donation-ledger
recordSet.description: One record per promoted community donation (55 rows). Provenance, composition metadata, and review outcome for every community session; the file that makes the corpus extensible (new accepted donations append rows).

field.name: label
field.description: Donation label, e.g. 'anonymous-donor-submission-86ff44fe'; directory name under data_archive_release_v2/data/donations/ holding manifest.json, CONSENT.md, and review_report.json.

field.name: submission_id
field.description: Relay staging submission id.

field.name: decision
field.description: Review outcome: ACCEPTABLE (54) or SUPERSEDED (1; a same-lineage older row replaced by a grown re-donation, linked via supersedes_submission/superseded_by).

field.name: agent
field.description: Coding-agent harness: 'Claude Code' (30) or 'Codex CLI' (25).

field.name: source_format
field.description: Transcript schema: claude-code-jsonl | codex-cli-jsonl. Selects which RecordSet (claude-code-records / codex-cli-records) describes the session file.

field.name: model
field.description: Model that drove the donated session (donor-reported, confidence-tagged), e.g. gpt-5.5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-8.

field.name: org
field.description: Model organization: Anthropic or OpenAI.

field.name: domain
field.description: Task domain: agentic-coding | web-frontend | manuscript-writing | non-coding-docs.

field.name: language
field.description: Primary programming language of the session ('mixed' for most).

field.name: records
field.description: Number of JSONL records in the redacted session (sums to 225,570 across all 55 rows).

field.name: turns
field.description: Intake turn count for the session as recorded at donation (sums to 12,337 across all 55 rows; 12,281 across the 54 ACCEPTABLE rows). Uses a broader definition than the paper's user turn (one user + assistant round); the analysis-definition counts are in figure_inputs_v2.0.csv (turns column, 12,210 over the 57 analysis sessions).

field.name: compactions
field.description: Number of in-session context compactions (donor-manifest value; cross-validated in compactions_rederived.csv).

field.name: privacy_tier
field.description: Donor-selected privacy tier: full_redacted (default) or user_minimized (additionally masks sensitive donor-authored spans). See DONOR_PRIVACY.md.

field.name: public_anonymous
field.description: True when the donor chose to appear publicly as an anonymous donor (all 55 rows). Public credit then uses 'Anonymous donor <id>'.

field.name: credit_name
field.description: Contributor credit name (handle or pseudonym allowed per CONSENT.md).

field.name: session_path
field.description: Relative path of the redacted session JSONL under data_archive_release_v2/ (joins ledger rows to the community-sessions FileSet).

field.name: session_sha256
field.description: SHA-256 of the redacted session artifact (used for exact-duplicate rejection at the relay).

field.name: conversation_fingerprint
field.description: Privacy-preserving structural fingerprint (fingerprint_version='structure-v1') linking same-conversation re-donations for lineage/supersession checks.

field.name: promoted_utc
field.description: UTC timestamp when the donation was promoted into the release archive (v2.0 range: 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-15).

recordSet.name: session-drift-summary
recordSet.description: Baseline benchmark result table: one row per session in the 57-session accepted population with its mean drift gap (real-context arm minus length-matched filler arm) from the compact_validation_v1 run. Population mean drift gap +0.1696; per-session means range -0.33 to +0.60.

field.name: session_id
field.description: Session identifier (founding label or donation label).

field.name: population
field.description: founding | community.

field.name: agent
field.description: Harness family of the source session (claude | codex).

field.name: n_cells
field.description: Number of evaluation cells behind the mean (3 checkpoints x 5 probes per arm).

field.name: mean_drift_gap
field.description: Mean judge-score gap between the real-session arm and the filler-control arm (positive = drift attributable to real context).

recordSet.name: session-figure-inputs
recordSet.description: One row per session in the accepted population: session-shape covariates and judge-free lexical drift proxies used for figures and drift predictors.

field.name: session_id
field.description: Session identifier.

field.name: population
field.description: founding | community.

field.name: agent
field.description: Harness family (claude | codex).

field.name: turns
field.description: User turns in the session.

field.name: compactions
field.description: In-session context compactions.

field.name: mean_resp_len_words
field.description: Mean assistant response length in words.

field.name: first_person_rate
field.description: First-person marker rate in assistant messages (lexical register proxy).

field.name: preamble_rate
field.description: Preamble-phrase rate in assistant messages (lexical register proxy).

field.name: disclaimer_rate
field.description: Disclaimer-phrase rate in assistant messages (lexical register proxy).

field.name: resp_len_late_minus_early
field.description: Late-session minus early-session mean response length (within-session verbosity shift, words).

field.name: n_assistant_msgs
field.description: Number of assistant messages (the length variable that predicts drift in the predictors analysis).

recordSet.name: compactions-rederived
recordSet.description: One row per session file (58 = 54 accepted community + 1 superseded duplicate + 3 founding; analyses use the 57 accepted sessions, 169 compaction events): compaction counts independently re-derived from the JSONL compaction markers, reconciled against donor manifests and figure inputs. agree=True for all rows.

field.name: session_id
field.description: Session identifier.

field.name: harness
field.description: claude_code | codex_cli.

field.name: n_records
field.description: JSONL record count of the session file.

field.name: n_compactions_jsonl
field.description: Compactions counted from top-level JSONL markers (Claude Code: system/compact_boundary; Codex CLI: compacted).

field.name: n_compactions_manifest
field.description: Compactions per the donor manifest (empty for founding sessions, which predate manifests).

field.name: n_compactions_figure_inputs
field.description: Compactions per figure_inputs_v2.0.csv.

field.name: agree
field.description: True when all available sources agree for this session (True for all 58 rows).
